scope: Read-only measurements of each first-pass JSON artifact after exact admission and byte-comparison gates. Scalar limb counts use the stored numerator/denominator arrays (observed unsigned 32-bit entries); they are not polynomial degree, coefficient-computation work, live heap, or a bound on arbitrary input. JSON depth measures the serialized value tree, not Rust stack use. Pre-fix archives are retained as a separate failed-determinism attempt, not a performance baseline. No parameter/source field is rewritten.
